regions.label: Writing desk
regions.observation: Three old cases, two unpaid debts, one clean page.

regions.label: Empty raven perch
regions.observation: An empty perch. No bird, no word, and no excuse to stop waiting.

regions.label: Case archive
regions.observation: Closed, abandoned, and one I still lied about.

regions.label: Chart chest
regions.observation: Ward plans, old soundings, and streets that changed their names before their habits.

regions.label: Iron-bound lockbox
regions.observation: A small lock for the things I could not afford to mislay.

regions.label: Archive crates
regions.observation: The cases nobody paid to have put in order.

regions.label: Footlocker
regions.observation: Spare linen, old leather, and enough room for a better life.

regions.label: Wardrobe
regions.observation: A coat for the rain. The rain never asked whether it was clean.

regions.label: Bed
regions.observation: Sleep was available. Peace charged extra.

regions.label: Washstand
regions.observation: Cold water and a towel worn thin enough to tell the truth.

regions.label: Hearth
regions.observation: The coals kept their own counsel.

regions.label: Rain-streaked window
regions.observation: Rain on the glass. A tired sill-ward kept the worst of it outside.

regions.label: Exit to Sable Row
regions.observation: The hall smelled worse, but at least it led somewhere.
